data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for integrating Yandex.MapKit in Android and iOS applications.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display and interact with Yandex maps on both Android and iOS. It supports working with map objects like placemarks, polylines, polygons, and circles, as well as features like routing, address search, and displaying user location.
use_when: You need to display Yandex maps in a Flutter application.
You require routing, geocoding, and address suggestions using Yandex services.
avoid_when: You prefer using Google Maps or Apple Maps instead of Yandex services.
You need complex navikit support which is currently not supported.
strengths: Supports both lite and full variants of the native library.
Comprehensive feature set including clusters, routing, and address suggestions.
weaknesses: Requires manual native setup for API keys and locales on both Android and iOS.
Yandex Mapkit works with only one language which cannot be changed after app launch.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a MapKit Mobile SDK API key from Yandex, configuring native iOS (AppDelegate.swift) and Android (MainApplication, AndroidManifest.xml, build.gradle) files, and setting permissions for internet and location access.
